name: Emulator verify runner (Mac launchd agent)
purpose: Separate emulator queue supervisor com.powos.verify-emu-runner, running queue.sh run-emu from ~/pw/emu-runner (or POWOS_RUN_ROOT/emu-runner). Enqueue kickstarts it; loading recovers persisted jobs. Nonzero exits, including bounded emulator lock timeouts, are restarted by launchd. Empty queues exit successfully without polling. Phone jobs and supervision are unchanged.
unbounded: macOS has no cgroups; one bash runner, bounded four-minute emulator lock waits, one emulator owner; launchd throttles restart attempts and no process remains when idle
